title: TicketRecord
description: One multi-turn customer support interaction. Schema version 1.0.0. This file is the committed contract (Constitution Principle I); the Pydantic model in src/ticket_dataset/schema/record.py is authoritative and exports this file, and a CI check fails if the two drift.

schema_version.description: The contract version this record was written against (FR-002).

record_id.description: Stable unique identifier: UUIDv5 over run_id/record_index, so a resumed run cannot reissue one (FR-003, FR-015b).

run_id.description: The run that produced this record; resolves to exactly one manifest (FR-003, FR-029).

record_index.description: The slot this record occupies in the run. Dense over [0, record_count) in a complete corpus (FR-012c, SC-013).

source_id.description: Domain prompt document identity as name@sha256-prefix (FR-003, FR-008a).

scenario.description: The subdomain scenario the model elaborated for this record (FR-008b).

turns.description: Ordered conversation turns. No maximum is assumed (spec Edge Cases); the per-run range is a configuration bound, not a contract bound (FR-009d).

index.description: Position in the conversation; ascends contiguously from 0 (FR-004).

content.description: Turn text. Must not be empty or whitespace-only (FR-009). Any Unicode is valid, including non-Latin, emoji, and RTL (spec Edge Cases).

resolved_at.description: Must not precede created_at. Required when resolution_status is 'resolved'; absent otherwise. The conditional is enforced by the Pydantic model and by the two allOf branches below.

coherence_score.description: Judge score retained so the corpus can be filtered by quality without re-judging (FR-009i). Every written record scores at or above the run's threshold (SC-009).

rubric_id.description: Rubric version that produced the score; a score is meaningless without it (FR-009g).

model_id.description: The model that actually produced the text. Per-record because a refusal fallback can change it mid-run (FR-027).

judge_model_id.description: The model that actually scored the record.
